verdict.rationale: UKVI documents a route for individuals to see the personal information it holds about them. That is a first-party way to obtain your own data, but the evidence shows no self-service export, no open or machine-readable formats, and no confirmation that the release covers all data. Missing for 10: documented self-service bulk export, open or machine-readable export formats, confirmation of complete data coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Find out how to see the personal information that UK Visas and Immigration holds about you.
